subject: Human Evolution
title: The Leakey Dynasty
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Leakey Dynasty.

hook.text: Louis and Mary Leakey spent decades in East Africa searching for human ancestors. It was a family affair.

buildup.text: In 1959, Mary found a massive-jawed skull at Olduvai Gorge, Tanzania: 'Zinj,' or Paranthropus boisei.

discovery.text: Their son Richard later found Homo habilis and Homo erectus skulls at Lake Turkana, Kenya.

twist.text: The Leakeys turned East Africa into the world's richest site for human fossils—a legacy of three generations.

climax.text: Their granddaughter Louise continues the work today, keeping Africa at the center of the story.

punchline.text: One family, three generations, countless ancestors found.
